name: [FREE AVA + X5] SANGKALA MOUNTAIN
desc:
Let's go to the summit! The mountain features 45 checkpoints, and the summit of the adventurers is designed for all players to enjoy the atmosphere with background music specially selected to experience the atmosphere of mountain climbing. 
Main features
📷 Free camera support for mobile and PC 
🎵 Various types of music 
🎭 Free Avatar Selection 
🔥 Visual aura for characters 
⟷️ All Hide (Title, GUI, Player) 
✨ Carry various shapes 
☘️ The map is now safe for mobile devices
